name: Discing With Friends
summary: Discing With Friends is a browser-based 3D disc golf game with single-player and online multiplayer play. Players explore six themed courses and choose front-nine, back-nine, or full eighteen-hole rounds across varied terrain and difficulty levels. A shared hub includes practice areas, character customization, and disc cosmetics. Between rounds, players can explore a casino resort with games using in-game gold, ride scenic trains and a Ferris wheel, visit rooftop lounges, and discover underwater areas.
